command: bash -c SUB=$(az account show --query id -o tsv) && TOKEN=$(az account get-access-token --query accessToken -o tsv) && until STATE=$(curl -s 'https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/'$SUB'/resourceGroups/rezolve-AI/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/brainpowa-northeurope/computes/LLM-T1-NC80?api-version=2023-04-01' -H 'Authorization: Bearer '$TOKEN | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get("properties",{}); print(p.get("state","unknown"))') && [ "$STATE" != 'Running' ] && [ "$STATE" != 'Stopping' ]; do echo "State: $STATE - waiting..."; sleep 10; done; echo Final state: $STATE
